items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: St. Claude and Governor Nicholas, they call it now. Used to be called by road. Now they call it Governor Nicholas.

ctx.x: You went to that church over on St. Claude, what is the name of this?
St. Augustine. St. Augustine. St. Claude and Governor Nicholas, they call it now. Used to be called by road. Now they call it Governor Nicholas.
And where were you married? Were you married in that church?
